profile.name: Yueteng (Laurence) Yu
profile.title: PhD Candidate at QUT | Advanced HMI Design for Automated Vehicles
profile.statement: I am motivated by a simple question: How can we design safer and user-centred automated driving interactions that benefit a broader population?
summary: I am a PhD candidate at Future Mobility Centre, Queensland University of Technology (QUT), researching advanced human-machine interfaces (HMIs) for automated vehicles.
My work focuses on multimodal HMI, bringing safety and better user experience in high levels of automated driving.

I have designed and organised studies across driving simulators, test tracks, open-road urban experiments and autonomous-vehicle data collection, with practical experience in multimodal sensing including DMS, IMU, ECG/EDA, EEG, eye tracking, physiological data, video and subjective measures.
Before QUT, I worked across Tsinghua University's HCI and intelligent transportation research environment, automotive HMI UX projects, and software engineering roles at PwC.
